correctness.rationale: Detailed balance derives the exact stationary measure. The rising-factorial summation identity and gamma ratio yield exp(alpha log m) on subcritical ranges; the collision product is 1 uniformly below n^(1/2-delta) and exponentially small above n^(1/2+delta). The sandwich proves Z_n->exp(c/2), the small-index cumulative sums prove the exact CDF, and a Gaussian endpoint tail rules out hidden mass at one-half. For alpha->0 but alpha log n->infinity the normalization asymptotics prove concentration at exponent one-half. Exact finite configuration detailed-balance checks pass; experiments are not infinite proof.
